subject: storytime
title: Unicorn and Yeti words
about: Unicorn is sparkly and can do magic, Yeti is big and furry and loves snowball fights, and in three short stories the two of them learn that being different is no reason not to be best friends. This level teaches the words the child will meet in the book, so the library copy is easier to read on his own.
tip: After the level, borrow the book from the library and read one of the three stories together each night.

book.author: Heather Ayris Burnell
book.source: a library favorite; this level teaches its words, the app does not contain the book
book.blurb: The first easy-reader comic about a unicorn and a yeti who meet in the snow and become friends.

passage.text:
Unicorn Yeti sparkly snow
hill ice cold hot
horn fur big magic
jump fun play best
new friends

cards.note: capital U, it is a name; the u says you; three parts: U-ni-corn
capital Y, it is a name; the i at the end says ee: Yet-ee
s-p blend; ar says ar; y at the end says ee: spark-lee
s-n blend; ow says long o
ll is two letters, one sound
magic e makes i say its name; c says s before e
the o says its name, like in old: kohld
ur says er, like in her
two parts: mag + ic; the g says j
all regular; m-p at the end
p-l blend, then ay says long a
all regular; s-t at the end
ew says oo, with a little y: nyoo or noo, both are right
ie says e; the s says z: frendz
